release_notes: OneMira C1 1.1.56: OTA-safe full 8MiB external Flash extension with resumable power-loss formatting. Legacy 0x000000-0x400000 layout is preserved. Battery low-voltage hardware validation remains explicitly unvalidated; this release is for real-device OTA and recording/power evidence.
